description: This file implements functions for handling file metadata, such as filling, comparing, and updating stat data structures, as well as checking file validity.

methods.name: unsigned int munge_st_size(off_t st_size)
methods.description: Converts a file size into an unsigned int, with special handling for exact multiples of 4 GiB to avoid marking files as racily clean.

methods.name: void fill_stat_data(struct stat_data * sd,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Fills a custom stat_data structure with data from a standard stat structure.

methods.name: void set_times(struct stat * st,const struct stat_data * sd)
methods.description: Sets the access and modification times in a stat structure based on the provided stat_data.

methods.name: void fake_lstat_data(const struct stat_data * sd,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Fakes an lstat result by populating a stat structure from stat_data.

methods.name: int match_stat_data(const struct stat_data * sd,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Checks if file data matches given stat_data, returning a bitmask of changed attributes.

methods.name: void stat_validity_clear(struct stat_validity * sv)
methods.description: Clears the stored stat_data in a stat_validity structure.

methods.name: int stat_validity_check(struct stat_validity * sv,const char * path)
methods.description: Checks if the file at a given path has changed since last recorded in stat_validity.

methods.name: void stat_validity_update(struct stat_validity * sv,int fd)
methods.description: Updates the stat_validity structure with current file metadata from an open file descriptor.

ctags.name: set_times
ctags.pattern: /^static void set_times(struct stat *st, const struct stat_data *sd)$/
